name: Reorganisation Instruction SD 14
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action reorganisation instruction details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

WithdrawalTransactionType.name: Withdrawal Transaction Type
WithdrawalTransactionType.definition: Identifies the reorganisation withdrawal transaction type.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique number assigned by the depository. Transaction identification will be either the DTC instruction reference number for reorganisation instructions (VOI) or the DAM reference number for custody / reorganisation deposits.

TransactionSequenceNumber.name: Transaction Sequence Number
TransactionSequenceNumber.definition: Number which further identifies DTC instruction reference number. Not applicable to reorganisation / custody deposits.

SecuritiesQuantityDetails.name: Securities Quantity Details
SecuritiesQuantityDetails.definition: Provides information about securities quantity linked to a corporate action option.

RejectionReason.name: Rejection Reason
RejectionReason.definition: Reason for which an inbound instruction message or a cancellation instruction message is rejected.

CustomerReferenceIdentification.name: Customer Reference Identification
CustomerReferenceIdentification.definition: Customer identification entered by client upon instruction submission.

ContactPerson.name: Contact Person
ContactPerson.definition: Party contact information for the given instruction.

UserReferenceNumber.name: User Reference Number
UserReferenceNumber.definition: Unique identification of the transaction used by the transmitting party.

ProtectSafekeepingAccount.name: Protect Safekeeping Account
ProtectSafekeepingAccount.definition: For cover protect instructions whereby one safekeeping account is covering on behalf of another safekeeping account. The protect safekeeping account will be the account which submitted the original protect instruction.

ContactPersonGuideline.definition: ContactPerson is required for voluntary offer instruction transaction (VOIT), protect transaction (PROT) and protect on behalf of another participant transaction (PROP); not required for cover protect instructions like cover protect transaction (COVR), cover protect directly to agent transaction (COVA) and cover protect on behalf of another participant transaction (COVP).
